comment: Vendored from PR #9 branch cursor/harness-p5-tool-catalog-440b (do not merge). CORE_TOOLS only.

tools.name: list_desks
tools.description: List thin desks in this tree. Product empty shell is desks: [].

tools.name: get_house_view
tools.description: Read the live house markdown for one desk. Does not write.

tools.name: get_pack_snapshot
tools.description: Read the compiled pack snapshot. Does not write.

tools.name: propose_house_from_current
tools.description: Propose a CONFIRMED house edit from the current file. Does not write the vault. Human GO / ACCEPT commits.

tools.name: commit_on_go
tools.description: Write house or register only after an explicit GO utterance. Never on FORMING. Never from this eval.

tools.name: get_risk_sor
tools.description: Read the risk-register SoR (08). Does not write.

tools.name: propose_add_risk
tools.description: Propose adding a named risk. Does not write the register.

tools.name: propose_risk_status
tools.description: Propose a status change on an existing named risk. Does not write.

tools.name: propose_keep_driver
tools.description: KEEP a named driver candidate. Not a house write.

tools.name: get_driver_sor
tools.description: Read the drivers SoR. Does not write.
